modalities.evidence: vital sign measurements made at the bedside

output.population: Over forty thousand patients who stayed in critical care units of the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center between 2001 and 2012
output.summary: Deidentified records from critical care stays, covering demographics, bedside vital signs, laboratory results, procedures, medications, caregiver notes, imaging reports and mortality, supporting epidemiology, clinical decision-rule and tool development studies.
